validation_tool_corrections: Original scene count now validates the explicit 74-scene recovery baseline and loads additional scenes too.
Failure parser no longer interprets checks=18 failures=0 as 18 failures; 14 parser cases verified.
Unknown engine ERROR now fails even at exit code 0; only narrow known environment/fault-injection cases are accepted and retained separately. Seven Python gate regressions pass.
Isolated editor imports rebuild script class and UID indices from current paths instead of copying stale migration caches.

Shared engine-error gate now also protects content runners, real signing validation, raw PCK creation and independent Block. Nineteen Python regressions include a real publication invocation with a zero-exit/error-producing fake engine.
product_decisions: Daily challenge retains restart-on-entry semantics; no main-style resume was added.
Content updates remain silent background checks; progress/cancel are APIs, not a mandatory update screen.
Generic large JSON delivery is independent of level tables; product validators remain explicit.
No broad page or GameState rewrite; only concrete lifecycle/contract defects changed.
coverage_limits: Passing assertion counts are not statement or branch coverage.
Page tests cover selected real-node lifecycle races and controlled UI waits, not every AB combination or natural gameplay sequence.
Desktop fault injection does not prove physical power-loss durability or mobile performance.

Entry atomicity includes committed main/daily identity and corresponding statistics, but UI/audio/SDK side effects are not part of the file transaction. Rewarded-ad retry intent survives cached-page reuse within the same day, not process termination without a durable SDK credential.

Win settlement and streak check-in are distinct transactions with explicit retry/skip. Post-success time_total and SDK telemetry retain coalesced/best-effort semantics. Explicitly leaving a failed-save prompt may discard unsaved results, as stated in the UI.
No real release binary or Android/iOS export was executed; build predicates were replaced only in temporary copies for release-branch checks.
